short01_workflow_precedent_not_authority.use: Process example only: acted guide, Original C transfer, exact-copy ASR, forced word alignment and continuous final Original C program audio. The Short 01 waveform contains different words and is not a Short 02 input. Its numeric call authority and owner acceptance do not transfer.

before_any_provider_call: Rehash the locked script, frozen prepared request and current visual index; stop if any bound bytes changed.

Obtain fresh owner authority for this exact Short 02 input, one Google guide call, one ElevenLabs transfer call, zero retries and explicit current spend or credit caps; verify live provider account status and current quote before submission.
Persist immutable request intent before each call. A timeout or uncertain response is a hold, not permission to retry.
guide_after_separate_authorized_call: Preserve raw response, receipt and decoded guide WAV without overwriting earlier failed attempts.
Probe the actual WAV format, duration, peak/clipping, start and end. Use the existing tail-energy rule of less than 0.02; passing it does not prove the final phoneme is complete.

Run local exact-copy ASR against the 103-token locked lexical sequence and listen to the opening, paragraph joins and complete final word before any transfer. A write/right-like ASR ambiguity or boundary uncertainty requires human review, not automatic acceptance.
If guide QC fails or is uncertain, stop; do not silently add silence, modify the source, transfer it or retry without a newly scoped decision.
original_c_after_separate_authorized_cal: Preserve the raw provider response and immutable transfer receipt; decode a local 48 kHz PCM master and verify sample count and complete ending.
Independently transcribe the final Original C waveform and require the exact normalized locked word sequence; diagnose any mismatch without rewriting the script.

Produce word-level forced alignment on the final waveform; require finite ordered nonnegative start/end times, every word end within media duration, and a measured post-speech tail. A transcript with a word past EOF is a timing failure, not a pass.
Owner listening still determines whether delivery sounds natural; technical ASR and alignment alone do not accept it.
matching_presenter_after_separate_author: Recalculate scenes 1 and 5 from final word timestamps with natural entry and exit handles; the provisional 0–8.2 and 30.3–37.8 second windows are not generation requests.
Use the accepted EP007 V5 identity/look and delivery baseline as reference only; its accepted moving clip says different words and cannot be reused as Short 02 speaking footage.

Check each new portrait 9:16 performance against its matching Original C audio at normal speed: exact words, connected articulation, closures, tail, likeness, natural gaze and gesture, and unobstructed face. Do not infer sync from provider success or container offset alone.

Discard generated clip audio. If separately authorized and needed, restore mouth timing to the exact Short 02 Original C segments; retain the continuous final Original C WAV as the sole program-audio source.
local_sound_on_candidate: Retiming must follow final narration word cues across all six spoken scenes; preserve the unresolved OWNER-ONLY? question, current-state trace, human judgment boundary and outside-scope exclusion.
Create verbatim word-timed captions from the final Original C clock, phone-safe and clear of face and interface labels. Provisional phrase guides are not captions.
Inspect the host-to-screen, screen-to-host and spoken-payoff-to-two-second-route cuts at adjacent frames and normal-speed playback; do not cover a word or gesture at a seam.

Run strict HyperFrames visual checks, render/decode and program-audio equivalence checks only when separately authorized, then provide a hash-bound sound-on phone preview for owner review. A clean silent check is not final-cut acceptance.
